title: Hearty Canadian Chicken Skewers
description: A malty and juicy Canadian dish featuring coriander seeds and a sweet glaze, perfect for a monsoon evening, this recipe is gluten-free friendly and serves as a great dinner option.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coriander seeds, honey, apple cider vinegar, malt syrup, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the chicken skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the glaze by whisking together malt syrup and honey in a small bowl.
During the last 2 minutes of cooking, brush the glaze over the chicken skewers.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let them rest for a few minutes before serving.
